TextBlock.Text: DARWIN APPROACHES, JULY 1988. Exercise PITCH BLACK's maritime phase places an American carrier group south of the Arafura against a mixed aggressor force flying Soviet and Chinese profiles.

A Bear G is running the maritime strike serial with a Badger tanker behind it. Dragon 41, the U-2, is high over the exercise box; the Nighthawk detachment faces the aggressor squadron's J-8s and MiG-23. Airborne and ship radar reports form the working picture.

Intercept the Bear before its simulated release line and protect Dragon 41 throughout the engagement. The Badger tanker is excluded from engagement. The umpires assess a simulated launch if the Bear reaches the line; the serial remains an exercise.
Exercise Director, PITCH BLACK 88, maritime phase

This is an exercise interception. Stop the Bear before its simulated release line, keep the U-2 safe and leave the Badger tanker out of the engagement. The umpires will assess the strike against the surface group if it reaches the line.
• Kill the Bear before its release line
• Keep Dragon 41 safe throughout the interception
• Do not engage the Badger tanker; it is excluded from this exercise serial
USS Kitty Hawk, F-14A and F-117 detachments, a B-52G, a U-2, an Italian Tornado on exchange. Aggressors: two J-8, a MiG-23, a Bear G, a Tu-16N tanker.
Complete the assigned task within 60 minutes. Command will close the operation at that deadline.
